programme.desc: Happy Birthday, Ladd. Ree makes a birthday meal for Ladd. She cooks chilli cheeseburgers served with inspired sides. And, she bakes a yellow cake with chocolate buttercream frosting. S10, Ep8

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: The Middles. Ree is spending time with her middle children. She makes them plenty of kid-friendly dishes, including creamy bow tie chicken alfredo and grilled fruit pizza. S10, Ep9

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Girls' Day Off. Ina enjoys a day out with two close friends. She makes them a pre-shopping coffee cake with a sunrise smoothie and then rustles up an easy lunch afterwards. S7, Ep3

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: L.A. Story. Ina's friends from LA are coming to visit, so she whips up a classy dinner in their honour. She makes a delicious three-course meal that looks fancy but is easy to make. S7, Ep4

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: 12 of the UK's best amateur bakers compete to be crowned the Great British Bake Off champion. The technical challenge sees them all making a coffee and walnut Battenberg cake. S2, Ep1

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The bakers start with a signature bake: a quiche. Next is the technical challenge where they must bake a tarte au citron. Finally, they have to deliver 24 sweet miniature tarts. S2, Ep2

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: Michel reveals his recipe for poached cod with orange and vermouth. Later, he uses leftover croissants and brioches to make a tasty dessert. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Making It Up Isn't Making Do. Food writer Nigel Slater demonstrates how to make hot chicken cakes with a herb mayo. And, he cooks a delicious bean soup. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Leftovers. Nigel uses leftovers from his Sunday roast to make chicken salad with couscous and oranges. And, he uses surplus mash potato to create bubble and squeak cakes. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Swiss, Sandwiches And Sausage. Guy Fieri stops in Portland, OR, and Charlotte, NC, to sample grilled cheese sandwiches with a twist, schnitzel, sausage and Swiss specialities. S26, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Beef, Lamb And Pig. Guy Fieri hunts down meaty favourites in Kentucky and North Carolina. He enjoys an Irish pub's cottage pie, Asian-barbecue fusion and pimento-topped burgers. S26, Ep5
